verdict.rationale: Zulip documents its own interactive bot framework: you can write and run custom bots, or run existing ones, that react to messages, and deploy them in production with the Zulip Botserver. That gives a first-party way to put a responsive bot into conversations, but nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI agent, so the AI behavior would have to be custom code the user writes. Missing for 10: first-party or ready-made AI agent bots, documented mention-triggered responses, documentation of adding a bot as a channel member, independent or hands-on corroboration.
